01Before Vim

Locked. Clunky. Unadopted.

The previous solution locked functionality and proved clunky, leaving expectations unmet and provider adoption low. To elevate its risk-documentation program, the ACO needed a tool providers would actually use across a fragmented, multi-EHR network.

- Prior tool locked functionality
- Limited provider adoption

02Our mission

Earn engagement. Scale everywhere.

Evolent aimed to elevate the ACO’s risk-documentation program after a previous software solution locked functionality, proved clunky, and saw limited provider adoption. The ACO needed a solution that would earn provider engagement, scale across a diverse EHR landscape, and deliver strong risk-adjustment performance.

- Win real provider adoption
- Scale across a diverse EHR landscape
- Deliver strong risk-adjustment performance

Care Insight, in clinical workflow

## Actionable data, _at the point of care_ in real time.

Evolent selected Vim for its intuitive, EHR-agnostic UI and seamless integration into clinical workflows. Deployed across 5 EHR types to support 125+ providers (25,000 patients) at 40+ practices, Vim’s Care Insight application surfaces actionable data directly at the point of care — enabling providers to address diagnosis gaps and engage in care-management opportunities without toggling between systems.

- EHR-agnostic UI across 5 EHR types
- Diagnosis gaps surfaced at the point of care
- Care-management opportunities in one place
